results.question: When should I submit my claim?

final.answer: You must submit travel expense claims within 30 calendar days after returning from the trip, and medical reimbursement claims within 60 calendar days after treatment. Annual leave requests should be submitted at least 10 working days before the first day of leave.

evidence.text:
Travel expense claims
Employees must submit travel expense claims within 30 calendar days after returning from the trip.

Medical reimbursement claims
Employees must submit medical reimbursement claims within 60 calendar days after treatment.

Annual leave requests
Submit annual leave requests in the leave portal at least 10 working days before the first day of leave.
